20 Lower O’Connell Street, Kinsale, Co. Cork

No. 20 Lower O’Connell Street is a three-bedroom detached home superbly positioned in the heart of Kinsale, within a stone’s throw of the town centre, restaurants, cafés, shops, the Yacht Club and everything this renowned coastal town has to offer.

Extending to approximately 128.6 sq. m. over three floors, the property is presented in good condition while offering enormous potential for its next owner to reconfigure, extend or simply put their own stamp on the house.

One of the standout features is the driveway to the side, providing valuable off-street parking – a major advantage in such a central Kinsale location. This generous side area also offers interesting potential for use as a private garden, an extension to the existing house or possibly as a separate site, subject to the necessary planning permission and professional advice.

The ground floor currently comprises a bedroom, kitchen, utility area and en-suite. There is excellent scope here to rethink the existing layout. Opening the kitchen into the current downstairs bedroom could create a spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and living area. The attractive bay window opens onto a small front terrace, providing the opportunity to create a lovely outdoor seating area directly off the main living space. The existing utility and en-suite arrangement could also potentially be reconfigured to provide a utility room and separate guest WC.

On the first floor, there is a sitting room, bedroom and bathroom. The sitting room could easily become a generous principal bedroom, depending on the requirements of the new owner.

The top floor provides a further double bedroom with en-suite facilities, creating a flexible layout across all three levels.

There is also a useful storage area beneath the property, ideal for bicycles, outdoor equipment and general storage.

The location is exceptional. Kinsale is one of Ireland's best-known coastal and gourmet destinations, celebrated for its restaurants, harbour, sailing and vibrant town centre. Cork Airport is approximately a 25-minute drive away, while regular bus services connect Kinsale with Cork City and surrounding areas.

With its central location, off-street parking, flexible three-storey accommodation and considerable scope for further development, No. 20 Lower O’Connell Street represents an exciting opportunity to create a very special home in the heart of Kinsale.
